verdictMeaning: correct = the status given is the one the advisory record's affected events and the manifest / freeze / plan evidence support. incorrect = it is not. cannot-tell = the record and the evidence do not decide it. A verdict is NOT a statement that the vulnerable code is reachable or that the platform condition (e.g. Windows-only) holds.
